definitions.explanation: A musical wind instrument, especially traditional Japanese flutes.
An instrument that makes a shrill sound when blown.

examples.japanese: {祭|まつ}りで{笛|ふえ}の{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえた。
examples.english: I heard the sound of flutes at the festival.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}のころ、{学校|がっこう}で{縦笛|たてぶえ}を{習|なら}った。
examples.english: When I was a child, I learned the recorder at school.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{竹|たけ}で{笛|ふえ}を{作|つく}るのが{上手|じょうず}で、よく{孫|まご}たちに{作|つく}ってくれた。
examples.english: My grandfather was good at making flutes from bamboo and often made them for his grandchildren.

examples.japanese: {静|しず}かな{夜|よる}に{遠|とお}くから{聞|き}こえてくる{笛|ふえ}の{音色|ねいろ}は、どこか{懐|なつ}かしい{気持|きも}ちにさせる。
examples.english: The tone of a flute heard from afar on a quiet night makes you feel somehow nostalgic.

examples.japanese: {審判|しんぱん}が{笛|ふえ}を{吹|ふ}いて{試合|しあい}を{止|と}めた。
examples.english: The referee blew the whistle and stopped the match.

examples.japanese: {警察官|けいさつかん}が{交差点|こうさてん}で{笛|ふえ}を{吹|ふ}いて{車|くるま}を{止|と}めた。
examples.english: The police officer blew a whistle at the intersection to stop the cars.

examples.japanese: {体育|たいいく}の{先生|せんせい}が{笛|ふえ}を{吹|ふ}くと、{生徒|せいと}たちは{走|はし}るのをやめて{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: When the PE teacher blew the whistle, the students stopped running and gathered together.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}のとき、{助|たす}けを{呼|よ}ぶために{防災|ぼうさい}{用|よう}の{笛|ふえ}を{持|も}っておくといい。
examples.english: It's good to have a disaster whistle on hand to call for help during an earthquake.

notes:
{笛|ふえ} is a general term that covers both musical flutes and signal whistles. The word is composed of {物|もの} + {音|おと} (thing + sound) in its historical form.

TYPES OF FLUTES:
- {横笛|よこぶえ}: transverse flute (played sideways)
- {縦笛|たてぶえ}: recorder (played vertically) — every Japanese student learns this in school
- {尺八|しゃくはち}: shakuhachi (traditional bamboo flute)
- フルート: Western concert flute

WHISTLE USAGE:
- {審判|しんぱん}の{笛|ふえ}: referee's whistle
- {防災|ぼうさい}{用|よう}の{笛|ふえ}: emergency whistle

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {笛|ふえ}を{吹|ふ}く: to play a flute / to blow a whistle
- {笛|ふえ}の{音|おと}: sound of a flute/whistle
- {笛|ふえ}が{鳴|な}る: a whistle sounds
- {物音|ものおと}ひとつしない: not a single sound
